_comment: Copy to attio.json (gitignored). Holds the Attio API token + field mapping. Attio is the PRIMARY CRM log: ensure each pipeline person exists, link them to the right deal, and log a note + follow-up task. Conservative by design: people may be created, but deals/companies and stage changes are never auto-created/changed; nothing is ever deleted. See ATTIO_SETUP.md.

techtower._objects_note: Object slugs the sweep will try to match a contact/company against, in priority order. Confirm these exist via GET /v2/objects.
techtower._match_note: Which attribute to match the email sender / company on, per object.

writeBack._people_note: Primary-CRM behaviour. ensurePersonExists: create the person in Attio if no email match (re-query first to avoid duplicates). linkPeopleToDeals: associate the person with the resolved deal when not already linked.
writeBack._deal_creation_note: When a NEW pipeline conversation is detected (EMAIL is the primary signal; corroborate with calendar invites you SENT and follow-up emails) and the company has NO deal yet, create one. STRICTLY ONE DEAL PER COMPANY, deduped on email domain -> companies.domains: if any deal already exists for that company, link to it instead of creating a second. Creating a deal also ensures the company (by domain) and links the people. Confirm stage slugs via GET /v2/objects/deals/attributes and map them in newDealDefaults below.

newDealDefaults._stageRules_note: First match wins, top→bottom; else defaultStage. Decide from email + invites sent + follow-ups. Map the RIGHT-hand values to YOUR pipeline's real stage names.

writeBack._optional_attrs: If these custom attributes exist on the object, the sweep will set them. Leave blank to skip. Use the attribute slug from GET /v2/objects/{object}/attributes.
writeBack._stage_note: Auto-advancing a deal stage is OFF by default and ALWAYS requires explicit approval in the run. Never set this to auto-close/auto-win.
